profile.register_text: Register: Bane NOR station page, track table (https://www.banenor.no/en/traffic-and-travel/railway-stations/-l-/lysaker/, read 2026-10-30): per track the platform length, height (mm above top of rail), width and type; no coordinates, so each platform is drawn on the OSM track centreline (see `x_geometry` per feature). Heights are Bane NOR's per-platform values, not classes.
